fields.statement: At a02ef9dd1 ran `go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run TestLiveRunWrite -v`: TestLiveRunWriteReachesWorktree, TestLiveRunWriteCommittedByRunsNextCommit and TestLiveRunWriteNoRunNoCopy all PASS. An accept made in the main checkout while run R1's worktree exists is copied byte for byte into the worktree's .rhiza/log together with its uncommitted open and propose, and the worktree's log folds cleanly with the change set accepted (fixes attempt 1's f2). With real git and a linked worktree, the run's next commit (CommitCheckWrites through commitOnly, which now adds mirroredPaths: untracked entries of the run's change set identical to the main checkout's) holds all three entries on the run's branch, HEAD:<path> equal to the main copy, and leaves nothing untracked (fixes f1). A change set with no live run, and a dry run, copy nothing to any worktree. Read the diff (live_run_mirror.go copyMissingEntries/mirroredPaths, run_leaves.go commitOnly); go vet ./internal/api is clean. A wider ./internal/api -run 'Commit|Evidence|Check|Mirror|LiveRun' run passed every test, then failed only the known .rhiza-root/usage.live.json state-folder guard, which this change does not touch.
